findings.title: Auto-Renewal and Price Increase
findings.source_text: This contract auto-renews for successive 12-month terms at Rs. 1,199/month unless written notice is given >=30 days before term end.
findings.explanation: Contract automatically renews at a higher price without 30 days notice.
findings.potential_consequence: Unexpected charges at a higher rate.

findings.title: Early Termination Fee
findings.source_text: If you terminate early, the early termination fee equals 50% of remaining monthly fees.
findings.explanation: You must pay half the remaining contract value if you cancel.
findings.potential_consequence: High cost to exit the contract early.

findings.title: Refund Restriction
findings.source_text: Refunds are restricted. They are only provided for an outage over 7 consecutive days.
findings.potential_consequence: You will not get money back for most issues.
